factual_observations: The package is narrowly selected for review of a proposed migration between versioned configuration schemas; an ordinary one-field config edit and general code review are excluded.
Review identifies affected/unaffected users, removed/renamed fields, defaults whose meaning changes, and a rollback path.
Delivered behavior requires local implementation evidence and validation is separately pass, fail or not_run with its environment; examples are not current evidence.
Missing evidence remains unavailable and no finding is fabricated.
The workflow returns findings and does not modify configuration, run migration, create issues, contact owners, install, activate, publish, grant tools or claim qualification/benefit.

reader_anchors.completeness: All three coherent package artifacts and the migration-specific review decisions, evidence states and exclusions are present.
reader_anchors.clarity: Selection, workflow, linked checklist and non-goals are consistent and do not depend on fixture examples as facts.
reader_anchors.usefulness: A reviewer can produce evidence-scoped migration findings without performing the migration or inventing authority.
